stage: M95 interpretation hypotheses frozen before heldout evaluation
primary_contrast: Within each seed, joint_three_corner versus intact_KL, plus each final versus its own initial. All six candidates retained.

hypotheses.name: Compatible distributed coordinates
hypotheses.prediction: Joint supervision improves simultaneous predicted-background/predicted-change responses across heldout task families while retaining natural KL and CE.
hypotheses.limit: Supports feasibility under native product prior; does not prove semantic features or minimal computation.

hypotheses.name: Isolated improvements still fail to compose
hypotheses.prediction: One or both isolated causal corners improve without combined replacement improvement.
hypotheses.implication: Retain background/change compatibility as an unresolved bottleneck; do not infer reusable units from local gains.

hypotheses.name: Task-specific tradeoff
hypotheses.prediction: Training targets improve but whole-task or source-group transfer fails, or natural KL/CE deteriorate.
hypotheses.implication: Supervision may specialize the coordinates rather than reveal reusable native structure.

hypotheses.name: Output-space limitation
hypotheses.prediction: Neither training arm reliably improves combined fidelity over the fixed full-projection initial states.
hypotheses.limit: This fixed experiment cannot uniquely distinguish optimizer limitations from output-space inadequacy; no automatic sweep.

metrics: native-probability-weighted response error in each of three corners at source/final/identity
cohorts: All32natural evaluationdocuments; all7whole-taskfamilies and fixed5qualifiedsubset; all14source-group pairs. Preserve weak/null/ineligible cases. These are previously evaluated heldouts, not pristine new tasks.
selection: No model, threshold, family, rank or step selection from evaluation. No single aggregate percent-understood score.
stop: Complete six-candidate audits and joint interpretation before new training; no semantic-manifold or new-task-discovery claim from this baseline.
